text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Even if I say it's a drag,
it's not like I'm tired or anything, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Training and racing are totally a breeze, y'know? Bring on whatever, right? Ready for a scrap 24/7, right? ......

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Daaah, crap! Don't mess with me, fatigue...!
Body! Move...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Espoir City keeps firing off confident remarks to herself,
but the fatigue from the race might be catching up to her...
